meta.notDerived: No data has been derived yet.

velocity.title: Velocity
velocity.description: How much each team planned into a sprint: the scope committed at the start (initial) against the scope it ended with (final).
velocity.chartTitle: Initial and final scope per sprint
velocity.chartLabel: Chart: initial and final scope by sprint
velocity.snapshot: Frozen at completion: initial {{initialMd}} MD, final {{finalMd}} MD

throughput.title: Throughput
throughput.description: What each team delivered: the work finished per week or month, and the scope done inside each sprint. The two views differ by design — a task finished after its sprint closed counts in the period only.

caption.TASK: Domain view: delivered in — a task counts in its own domain.
caption.EPIC: Domain view: earned in — a task counts in its epic's domain.

throughput.sprintCaption: The sprint view: what was done inside each sprint while it was in it, priced at the sprint's close. It ignores the domain, activity type and work category filters.
throughput.bucketTableLabel: Delivered per period, as a table

sprintConsistency.title: Sprint consistency
sprintConsistency.description: How a sprint's scope moved: what was committed, what was added and removed on the way, and where the final scope ended up.
sprintConsistency.scopeLabel: Chart: committed and delivered scope by sprint
sprintConsistency.partitionTitle: Where the final scope ended up
sprintConsistency.partitionCaption: Final scope = delivered + carried over + dropped, so each bar's height is the sprint's final scope.
sprintConsistency.partitionLabel: Chart: final scope split into carried over, delivered and dropped, by sprint
sprintConsistency.changesLabel: Chart: scope added and removed during each sprint
sprintConsistency.tableCaption: Man-days, with the item count in brackets.
sprintConsistency.snapshot: Frozen at completion: committed {{committed}} · final {{final}} · delivered {{delivered}} MD

minSample.distribution_one: Only {{count}} item in this selection — at least {{min}} are needed to show percentiles and a histogram.
minSample.distribution_other: Only {{count}} items in this selection — at least {{min}} are needed to show percentiles and a histogram.
minSample.share_one: Only {{count}} item started in this selection — at least {{min}} are needed to show a share.
minSample.share_other: Only {{count}} items started in this selection — at least {{min}} are needed to show a share.
minSample.none: Nothing to measure in this selection.

distribution.histogramLabel: Histogram: number of items per range

ratio.hint: A ratio of 1 means the actual cost equals the estimate; above 1 it cost more.

groupsCaption.distribution: Groups below the minimum sample show counts only.

taskAccuracy.title: Task estimation accuracy
taskAccuracy.description: How the actual cost of finished tasks compares with their estimate: actual man-days ÷ estimate. The estimate at start is the primary view; the estimate at done is the second.
taskAccuracy.startCaption: Primary view — the estimate the team committed to when work began.
taskAccuracy.doneCaption: Second view — the estimate as it stood when the task finished.

excluded.neverStarted: Never started, so no estimate at start
excluded.unestimatedAtStart: No estimate at start (including estimated late)

epicAccuracy.title: Epic estimation accuracy
epicAccuracy.description: How the actual cost of finished epics compares with their OWN estimate: actual man-days ÷ own estimate. The sum of the child estimates is shown beside it, never used as the estimate.
epicAccuracy.startTitle: Against the own estimate at start
epicAccuracy.doneTitle: Against the own estimate at done

excluded.noActual: No time logged on the epic or its children
excluded.neverStarted: Never started, so no estimate at start
excluded.unestimatedAtStart: No own estimate at start (the child sum is never used)

epicAccuracy.epicsTruncated: Showing the newest {{count}} epics; the distributions above count all of them.

adjustments.title: Estimate adjustments
adjustments.description: How often an estimate changes after work has started, and by how much between start and done. An estimate that only appeared after start is counted separately, never as an infinite change.
adjustments.changeHint: (estimate at done − estimate at start) ÷ estimate at start; +25% means the estimate grew by a quarter.

excluded.estimatedLate: Estimated late — no estimate at start
excluded.unestimated: No estimate at start or at done (or never started)

adjustments.lateNote: Estimated late is included in Changed after start.
adjustments.domainViewNote: The domain view applies to tasks; epics always read their own space.

epicsNotPerPerson: Epics aren't attributed to individual people, so there are no epic figures for a single person.
